description: Fork of exp111 bumping nap from 12 to 14 (table_dim 4096 -> 16384, 4x larger). Single-table-per-output regime: tph*n_sparse=n_outputs per head. Per-layer LUT weights: qk 6*64*16384*1=6.29M, v 6*64*16384*1=6.29M, out 1*384*16384*1=6.29M = 18.88M (vs exp108's 13.63M per layer). Total LUT weights 113M; each output covers 16384 input combinations via 1 table. Other settings (E=384, d_qk=32, d_v=64, classic skip, balanced) match exp111.
